summary: Ivanhoe Electric filed an 8-K furnishing a press release and slideshow under Item 7.01 and disclosing under Item 8.01 the completion of an updated S-K 1300 Preliminary Feasibility Study Technical Report Summary dated September 23, 2026 for its Santa Cruz Copper Project west of Casa Grande, Arizona. Third-party qualified persons including BBA, Worley, Burns & McDonnell, Haley & Aldrich, INTERA, KCB, Stantec and Tetra Tech prepared the study; none hold ownership, royalty or other project interests. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine technical disclosure, not a special situation; watch project capex, permitting and resource conversion.
